usedFor: Signwell holds documents out for signature, and MailerLite receives the signer through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Completed” in Signwell, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A completed signature adds the signer to MailerLite, or updates the existing subscriber.

watchOut: “Document Viewed”, “Document Sent” and “Document Completed” fire at different stages, so choose one for each template.
